message.text:
h11.

**1st: `store.User` (~7 packages, 99 references); 2nd: `store.Memo` (~6 packages, 73 references)**

The data layer is the `store` package, whose persistent entity types are declared in `/bench/repo/store/*.go`: `User` (`store/user.go:29`), `Memo` (`store/memo.go:35`), `Attachment` (`store/attachment.go:16`), `UserSetting` (`store/user_setting.go:13`), `UserIdentity` (`store/user_identity.go:8`), `Inbox` (`store/inbox.go:24`), `MemoRelation` (`store/memo_relation.go:16`), `MemoShare` (`store/memo_share.go:6`), `Reaction` (`store/reaction.go:7`), `IdentityProvider` (`store/idp.go:12`), and `InstanceSetting` (`store/instance_setting.go:14`).

Counting distinct Go packages outside the `store/` tree that mention each type:

| Type | Packages outside `store` | Total references |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `User` | 7 | 99 |
| `Memo` | 6 | 73 |
| `Attachment` | 4 | — |
| `Inbox`, `MemoRelation`, `MemoShare` | 3 each | — |

`store.User` appears in `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/router/rss`, `server/router/fileserver`, `server/auth`, `server/router/frontend`, and `server/notification`. Representative uses are the authentication plumbing in `server/auth/authenticator.go` (return type of `AuthenticateByRefreshToken` and `AuthenticateByPAT`, plus the context helper `SetUserInContext` in `server/auth/context.go`) and the email path in `server/notification/email.go`.

`store.Memo` covers the same set minus `server/auth` and `server/router/fileserver`, plus the payload rebuilder in `server/runner/memopayload`. If you exclude the separate `server/router/api/v1/test` package, the counts become 6 and 5, so the ranking is unchanged either way.
